identity.name: Campus Edge on Pierce
identity.status: verified by named/address OSM way and corroborating LiDAR footprint plus current orthophoto

plan_geometry.status: source-backed footprint, approximate campus local projection
plan_geometry.primary_source: Indiana 2016-2020 LiDAR-derived Building Footprints, OBJECTID 407824, LiDAR year 2018
plan_geometry.cross_check: OpenStreetMap way 886359911; 0.914456 intersection-over-union and 1.0616 m centroid gap
plan_geometry.method: EPSG:4326 WGS 84 to project local conversion in modular/README.md; X east, Y north, Z up, meters
plan_geometry.uncertainty: Horizontal coordinates use a local degree approximation and are not survey-grade. LiDAR roofs are not necessarily wall outlines. Decorative balconies and trim extend about 1-1.3 m beyond structural footprint.

vertical_geometry.ground_reference: model ground datum z=0 m; no independent surveyed elevation adjustment
vertical_geometry.method: 2018 NDHM pixel centers inside the OSM footprint, grouped into three approximate Y bands georeferenced from the 2023 orthophoto extent using the project local conversion. Per-zone values are normalized surface medians, not eaves.
vertical_geometry.uncertainty: 5-ft NDHM cells include rooftop equipment, edges, and possible tree returns. Orthophoto row boundaries are approximate and clipped to the GIS ring; per-tower eaves, floor counts, and exact roof-step elevations are unknown.
vertical_geometry.roof_equipment_extent_m_approx: up to z=37.387 m from approximate rooftop equipment geometry
